allowList.title: Allowed sites
allowList.description: Site patterns Claude may act on (replaces the user's list). Same syntax as the popup.

blockList.title: Blocked sites
blockList.description: Site patterns Claude may never act on (replaces the user's list).

productionWrites.title: Writes in production orgs
productionWrites.description: "ask" (default): the user may allow writes in a production org for a limited time. "never": production orgs stay read-only for Claude.

orgSetupReading.title: Reading org setup
orgSetupReading.description: false: Claude may not read org setup (fields, picklists, layouts) through the UI API, even if a user allows it.
